findings.fix: Fixed reviewed policy hashes and exact payload allowlist are checked before execution; full original gate/profile/limitation semantics checked; use reviewed Git verifier and optional externally obtained manifest digest.
findings.investor_impact: A fake twelve-gate checker was accepted after its mutable mapping/manifest hashes were recomputed. This invalidates any claim that V1 necessarily ran the original assertions under such tampering.
findings.title: Mutable hashes could launder a substituted historical checker
findings.verification: A coordinated fake-checker substitution with mutable hashes recomputed must reject before execution.

findings.fix: Evidence registry binds bytes, supported task IDs, result/exit status and current verifier code; protected role-approval tasks cannot be auto-promoted by preparer records.
findings.investor_impact: V1 accepted DD-010 as verified when its only evidence was the root README; evidence existence was mistaken for acceptance.
findings.title: A README could qualify an owner approval task
findings.verification: README-only promotion, failed receipt and stale code binding reject.

findings.fix: Retain the 93 task IDs as a backlog; lead V2 with one current-state page and five decision tracks. Remove task-count readiness percentages and unjustified uniform effort ranges.
findings.investor_impact: The 27-page packet showed 27.96% implementation and 26.88% verification for a mixed future register; these quantities do not measure scientific, product or commercial derisking.
findings.title: 93 tasks and preparation percentages obscure the investment decision
findings.verification: Current-state and decision validators report zero investment gates met, with separate technical receipts.

findings.fix: Explicit exercise matrix and DG-2 frozen integration gate; no claim of an end-to-end PLGA engine run.
findings.investor_impact: The PLGA study is an isolated adapter, while owner/curation/recovery examples are different synthetic/historical scenarios.
findings.title: The benchmark has not qualified the deployed product
findings.verification: Every scientific proof card says isolated adapter/no LLM; an integration claim requires its own actual-owner evidence.

findings.fix: Retain full inference beside scientific proof cards; define DG-4 frozen new-panel/margin/replicate gate and unfavorable-result branch.
findings.investor_impact: All ten planned stage-2 intervals include zero on a development-exposed corpus. Neither replay nor new formatting creates external validation.
findings.title: No independent scientific lift or transfer is established
findings.verification: No winner badge or ROI inference; all 12 cells and 10 contrasts remain linked unchanged.

findings.fix: Commercial hypothesis ledger, current-alternative comparison and DG-3 decision protocol; unknown thresholds remain blocking and unestimated.
findings.investor_impact: Workflow composition/provenance could be valuable, but there is no documented buyer interview, matched value study, adoption evidence or pricing evidence.
findings.title: No measured buyer value or willingness to pay
findings.verification: No customer/pricing/savings invented; primary value metric and decision margin must be frozen before a pilot.

findings.fix: Contribution/provenance matrix, payload rights gate and candid unresolved ownership status; keep existing terms and original attribution.
findings.investor_impact: Public visibility, existing proprietary terms and data attribution do not prove exclusive ownership or permission for every proposed reuse.
findings.title: License/provenance is not a chain-of-rights conclusion
findings.verification: Review each selected object, not a blanket claim that this packet resolves rights or patentability.

findings.fix: Primary-source AiiDA/LangGraph acknowledgement and contribution-specific matrix; measure claimed integration/value rather than marketing a universal first.
findings.investor_impact: Workflow provenance and stateful agent orchestration are established adjacent capabilities. The packet does not prove competitor absence or exclusivity.
findings.title: The moat is a hypothesis and adjacent foundations already exist
findings.verification: No unsupported world-first/patent/moat assertion; source-backed present mechanism distinct from future commercial advantage.

findings.fix: Bound stdout/stderr, reject malformed whole JSON, use a shared deadline and isolated child Python, and run the required capsule pass once.
findings.investor_impact: capture_output was memory-unbounded, parser accepted only the last output line, and verify-source ran capsule checks twice.
findings.title: Checker subprocesses were weakly bounded and checks repeated
findings.verification: Output flood, timeout, leading garbage JSON and duplicate execution regression cases fail safely.

findings.fix: Stricter collection/phase/evidence validation and canonical JSON-pointer array indexes; fixed safe CLI error output.
findings.investor_impact: Null arrays and wrong shapes could escape clean rejection; source ranges/phase membership and canonical array selectors were insufficiently checked.
findings.title: Task/JSON shape and pointer validation had gaps
findings.verification: Null/malformed arrays, wrong phase membership, negative index and bad pointer escapes reject.

findings.fix: Resolve output paths before checkout/inside-capsule checks and reject existing/linked destinations. Keep the trusted-directory/TOCTOU limit explicit.
findings.investor_impact: V1 used absolute paths and checked only the immediate output parent; an ancestor symlink could point back into the checkout.
findings.title: Output aliases could evade the checkout exclusion
findings.verification: Ancestor link into repository, existing output and archive-inside-payload aliases reject without overwriting.

findings.fix: Reports enumerate executed, historical-only and omitted checks; DG-2 requires current installed-owner proof separately.
findings.investor_impact: A fresh receipt check validates old assertions; it does not rerun old process/recovery scenarios or assess current installed service health.
findings.title: Historical pass labels could be mistaken for current readiness
findings.verification: Source and capsule scope fields differ correctly; no historical pass is labeled fresh process execution.

findings.fix: Unassigned roles and unapproved budgets are explicit at every decision track; remove uncalibrated effort ranges and schedule promises.
findings.investor_impact: A named role is not an assigned person. Uniform task-minute estimates and a six-hour aspiration do not establish delivery capacity.
findings.title: Roles and effort ranges do not establish staffing or budget
findings.verification: Activation of future work needs named ownership, a frozen scope and an approved budget; current task authorizes only bounded revision/publication.

findings.fix: Separate review coverage statement; local preparer inspected actual artifacts and ran the confirmed code probes.
findings.investor_impact: The independent worker was denied Library artifact access and reviewed only supplied reconciliation. It cannot be called an independent full-PDF/code audit.
findings.title: The additional reviewer did not inspect the delivered artifacts
findings.verification: Review credits state precisely which material was and was not accessible.

review_scope: Local preparer reviewed actual V1 PDF, task ledger and code; additional worker reviewed reconciliation only after Library access denial. Not independent scientific validation or legal opinion.
